# Daily

> An opt-in calendar. Sign in with Google, sync your calendar, decide event-by-event what the world sees. Public profiles live at /u/[username]. Includes interview/opportunity pipeline tracking with notes, contacts, and an AI prep-brief generator.

## Pages

- [/](https://dayrun-app.netlify.app/) — Home.
- [/explore](https://dayrun-app.netlify.app/explore) — Public profiles, sorted by recent activity.
- [/app](https://dayrun-app.netlify.app/app) — Private dashboard for signed-in users.
- [/app/pipeline](https://dayrun-app.netlify.app/app/pipeline) — Interview / referral / opportunity tracker.
- [/app/settings](https://dayrun-app.netlify.app/app/settings) — Username + profile settings.
- [/u/[username]](https://dayrun-app.netlify.app/u/charltonuw) — Public profile.
- [/about](https://dayrun-app.netlify.app/about) — About the project.
- [/privacy](https://dayrun-app.netlify.app/privacy) — Privacy practices.

## Built with

Next.js 16, Firebase (Auth + Firestore), Google Calendar API, Claude API. Part of the azoni.ai launchpad portfolio.
